summary: Iter 71 verification of (1) Admin Inventory-Log CSV export and (2) Retailer Rewards-Statement PDF. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases green (4 pre-existing unit + 6 new integration in test_iter71_csv_pdf_integration.py). Endpoints validated end-to-end via UI as well. Fixed one FastAPI route-ordering bug that caused GET /api/admin/b2b/inventory/log to return 404 ('Product not found') because it was being captured by the earlier-declared /{product_id} route. Reordered so /log and /log/export.csv are declared before /{product_id}. Also flagged a spec-violation UX bug in the retailer rewards page: the Download-Statement button is disabled when the ledger is empty, which contradicts the spec (empty ledger must still yield a valid PDF with '— No ledger entries yet —' row). Backend supports empty ledger correctly (validated via test_statement_returns_valid_pdf_bytes_for_empty_ledger + direct hit with a fresh retailer session that has 0 entries — got a 3.4 kB %PDF/%%EOF file). Frontend end-to-end flow works when at least one ledger entry exists (3474-byte PDF downloaded via UI click). Admin CSV UI works: header row matches spec exactly, filename addrika-inventory-log-<stamp>.csv, at least one data row present, ProductName column enriched with 'Name (weight)' pattern (e.g. 'Bold Bakhoor (50g)'). Anonymous callers get 401 on both endpoints as expected.

minor.issue: Was shadowed by GET /{product_id} due to declaration order — returned 404 'Product not found'. FIXED by moving the /log and /log/export.csv route definitions above /{product_id} in routers/admin/admin_b2b_inventory.py. Note: /log/export.csv accidentally worked because /{product_id} only captures single-segment paths.

ui_bugs.issue: Download-Statement button is disabled={downloading || entries.length === 0}. Empty-ledger retailers cannot download a statement, contradicting the spec ('Empty ledger should still produce a valid PDF'). Backend/renderer already handle 0-entry ledger correctly. Fix: drop the `entries.length === 0` clause so the button stays enabled once auth+data have loaded.

action_items: Frontend: remove `|| entries.length === 0` from the disabled expression on the rewards-download-statement-btn so empty-ledger retailers can still generate a PDF (per spec).
(Done by tester) Backend route reordering in admin_b2b_inventory.py — no further action needed but review the diff.
critical_code_review_comments: FastAPI route ordering is fragile — recommend moving static segments (/log, /export.csv, /low-stock/*, /nudges/*, /restock-nudges/*) above any /{path_param} routes as a codebase-wide convention. Currently /{product_id}/status and /{product_id}/log still work because they have a second segment, but adding a future top-level /status or /log/<x> could regress.

The datetime split in admin_inventory_log_csv (line ~163: `(r.get('created_at') or '').split('T')[0] + ' ' + (r.get('created_at') or '').split('T')[1][:8]`) will IndexError on any log row whose created_at is not ISO-8601 with a 'T'. Guard with a try/except or use datetime.fromisoformat.

Rewards-statement PDF endpoint sorts ledger newest-first (`sort('earned_at', -1)`), but the spec calls for a 'full chronological ledger table with running balance column'. Chronological usually means oldest→newest so the running balance can accumulate. Confirm intent with main agent — if oldest-first is expected, the renderer needs to reverse the list or the query direction needs to flip.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (button correctly renders and streams the PDF, but disabled for empty-ledger case per UI bug above)

rca of the issue: FastAPI resolves routes in registration order. `/{product_id}` was registered before `/log`, so any GET /log request matched the parameter route with product_id='log' → 404 Product not found. This only affected /log (list); /log/export.csv accidentally escaped because a two-segment path can't match a single-segment `/{product_id}` template. Mitigation: static path segments must be declared before parameterized ones. Applied fix in admin_b2b_inventory.py.
